en.askTitle: Swap in your own child, address and budget and get the same school-registration plan for your family
en.runTitle: Singapore Primary 1 registration for a new PR family: son born 2021, renting in Bukit Timah

fields.label: Child’s birth date and citizenship
fields.value: PR son born in 2021, entering Primary 1 in January 2028; both parents became PRs in 2025

fields.label: Genuine school links
fields.value: None: neither parent studied at a Singapore primary school

fields.label: Current or proposed home area
fields.value: Renting a condo in Bukit Timah, may move

fields.label: Rent and school budget
fields.placeholder: e.g. S$4,500 a month rent, school fees under S$400 a month

fields.label: Commute and student-care needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. under 30 minutes each way, after-school care until 6 pm

en.template: Help us plan Singapore primary-school registration using {child}, {links}, {home}, {budget} and {commute}. Separate eligibility from historical chances. Flag missing dates, PR caps, fees and residence conditions. Ask before contacting schools, opening authenticated forms or sharing family documents.

phases.title: Check the Ministry’s current rules, the 2027 changes and the fees
phases.note: Phases, PR priority, renter address rules, fees
phases.judgment: It did not treat Phase 3 as a fallback for PR children: it is for international students, and unsuccessful PR children are posted to a school with a vacancy. It also warned that a school with fewer applicants than places is not automatically safe for a PR: Bukit Timah balloted PRs with 104 applicants for 132 places because of its PR cap.

phases.title: Collect past school vacancy figures and distances from official records
phases.note: School-by-school vacancies, balloting and home distance
phases.judgment: It left gaps empty rather than filling them: only 2025 school-level figures were verified, and the 2024, 2026 and Phase 3 figures it could not recover are marked unconfirmed. The eight-school table is labelled as a wider-area comparison, not eight schools within 2 km.

phases.title: Build the guide and sources page, then check desktop and phone views
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer found one misleading phrase: the draft said Phase 2B includes an “active community leader”, but the source says “active grassroots leader”. It was corrected to the source’s wording.

workers: Pulled the Ministry of Education’s past vacancy and balloting records for schools around Beauty World and King Albert Park
Checked the Ministry’s current rules: phases, PR versus citizen priority, renting and moving, fees and the 2027 changes
Checked the finished guide against the original sources, rule by rule and table by table

zh.askTitle: 把孩子、住址和预算换成你家的情况，得到同样的小一报名规划
zh.runTitle: 新加坡小一报名（新 PR 家庭）：2021 年出生的儿子，租住武吉知马

fields.label: 孩子生日及公民身份
fields.value: 儿子是 PR，2021 年出生，2028 年 1 月入读小一；父母 2025 年获 PR

fields.label: 真实学校关系
fields.value: 没有：父母都没有在新加坡读过小学

fields.label: 现住或拟搬入区域
fields.value: 租住武吉知马的公寓，可能搬家

fields.label: 房租和学校预算
fields.placeholder: 例如：房租每月 4,500 新元，学费每月不超过 400 新元

fields.label: 通勤和托管需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：单程通勤 30 分钟内，放学后托管到下午 6 点

zh.template: 请根据 {child}、{links}、{home}、{budget} 及 {commute}，帮我们规划新加坡小学报名。把申请资格与往年机会分开，标出待确认日期、PR 上限、费用及居住条件。联系学校、打开登录表格或分享家庭文件前，请先征求同意。

phases.title: 核对教育部现行规则、2027 年变化和费用
phases.note: 报名阶段、PR 优先次序、租户地址规定、费用
phases.judgment: 它没有把第三阶段当成 PR 孩子的退路：那是留给国际学生的，报不上的 PR 孩子会被安排到有空缺的学校。它还提醒，报名人数少于名额的学校对 PR 也不一定稳妥：武吉知马小学有 104 人报名、132 个名额，却因 PR 上限仍对 PR 抽了签。

phases.title: 从官方记录收集往年学校空缺和距离
phases.note: 逐校空缺、抽签情况和居所距离
phases.judgment: 没查到的地方它宁可留空：只核实了 2025 年各校数据，查不到的 2024、2026 年及第三阶段数字都标成“未确认”。八所学校的表格也注明是扩大范围的对比，并不是八所 2 公里内的学校。

phases.title: 制作指南和来源页，并检查电脑与手机显示
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事挑出一处容易误导的措辞：初稿写第 2B 阶段包含“积极的社区领袖”，而来源写的是“积极的基层领袖”。已改回来源原词。

workers: 查教育部公布的往年空缺和抽签记录，覆盖 Beauty World、King Albert Park 一带的学校
核对教育部现行规则：各报名阶段、PR 与公民的优先次序、租房和搬家规定、费用及 2027 年变化
对照原始来源，逐条核对成稿里的规则和表格
